title: Long Context Eval
motto: Gemini 3 Pro advertises 10M tokens of context. At 1M tokens, 8-needle MRCR drops to 26.3%. Advertised ≠ usable. Long-context evaluation tells you the actual capacity of the model you are shipping on.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Gemini 3 Pro advertises 10M tokens of context. At 1M tokens, 8-needle MRCR drops to 26.3%. Advertised ≠ usable. Long-context evaluation tells you the actual capacity of the model you are shipping on.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: You have a 200-page contract. The model claims a 1M-token context. You paste the contract in and ask: "What is the termination clause?" The model answers — but answers from the cover page because the termination clause sits at 120k tokens deep, past where the model actually attends.
This is the 2026 context-capacity gap. Spec sheets say 1M or 10M. Reality says 60-70% of that is usable, and "usable" depends on the task.

steps.title: Implement longctx
steps.body: Write the function from scratch in the workspace. Run when ready — all tests must pass.
